resources.string: Shared lists for groceries, places, plans and anything else.

You leave every space. A space with nobody else in it is deleted with its lists. A space you share goes on without you; if you own it, the next member becomes its owner. Items you added stay there. Your Google account is not touched. Google will ask you to choose your account once more.
